event_name: International Day of the Girl Child
quote: A girl is not the future she is the present. Every barrier she faces today is a cost the whole world pays tomorrow.
explanation: Observing International Day of the Girl Child.
long_explanation:
A day of observance should lead to an honest conversation.

When girls and women access quality education and equal economic opportunities, the benefits ripple across entire generations.

At Jalte Diye Foundation, our social initiatives break down barriers to learning, ensuring every girl and woman has the tools to achieve self-reliance.

Mentor, recommend, or share an educational opportunity with a young woman in your community today.
